desc: Parse N, K, and the NK-1 edges; build adjacency lists; handle K=1 as an immediate Yes.
Root the tree at 1 and compute subtree sizes modulo K with an iterative post-order DFS to avoid recursion depth issues.
At each vertex, count children with nonzero residue; if count > 2 -> No; if count == 2 require the two residues sum to K-1.
Apply the root condition: for K>1, root cannot have count 0; if root count == 1 require its residue == K-1.
Output Yes/No and test against the samples plus small brute-force trees.
